name: tracetoon
description: Creates your PR with a description written from your Cursor session logs, and an optional one-off comic. Every claim is checked against what your agent actually did before the PR is posted. On 61 real pull requests from 12 repositories, AI judges who agreed on a winner preferred the descriptions from Tracetoon's evidence graph to its earlier multi-agent workflow 83 to 34 on Codex and 69 to 17 on Claude Code, at 46% and 31% lower cost per PR.
